import importlib.util, os
def load(name, path):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
    m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m); return m

flags = load("flags","units/flags/flags.py").Impl()
assert flags.parse(["--k","--v"]) == {"values":{},"flags":{"k":True,"v":True},"positional":[]}
assert flags.parse(["-abc","--k","-5","x","--","--y"]) == {"values":{"k":["-5"]},"flags":{"a":True,"b":True,"c":True},"positional":["x","--y"]}
assert flags.parse(["--k="]) == {"values":{"k":[""]},"flags":{},"positional":[]}
assert flags.parse(["--x","y","--x"]) == {"values":{"x":["y"]},"flags":{"x":True},"positional":[]}
print("flags extra ok")

iv = load("intervals","units/intervals/intervals.py").Impl()
assert iv.merge([[1,2],[4,5]],1) == [(1,5)]
assert iv.merge([[1,2],[4,5]],0) == [(1,2),(4,5)]
assert iv.subtract([[0,10]],(4,6)) == [(0,3),(7,10)]
assert iv.subtract([[0,4]],(4,9)) == [(0,3)]
assert iv.subtract([[5,7],[1,3]],(2,6)) == [(1,1),(7,7)]
assert iv.total_length([[0,2],[2,4]]) == 5
print("intervals extra ok")

sch = load("schedule","units/schedule/schedule.py")
assert sch.slots([(0,60),(30,90),(120,150)],30) == [(0,90),(120,150)]

assert sch.slots([(0,10),(10,20)],0) == [(0,10),(10,20)]
assert sch.slots([(0,10),(10,20)],1) == [(0,20)]
